author: @vprusso

code_snapshot.gate: qldpc-challenge verify stack at e43a53888 (verify/validate_candidate.py through research/kit/coordination.gate_and_record)

subgroups: every subgroup generated by one or two elements, one per conjugacy class, index 2 to 8
comparators: regular lifts over every abelian group of order 2 to 8 and over S3, D4, Q8, same base shapes

shapes.1x2: exhaustive where the pair count is at most 100,000, else 100,000 sampled
shapes.2x2: 1,500 sampled per (group, subgroup), in an earlier display-keyed pass (full3); its gated distances stand as codes, its class counts do not

entries: single group elements and sums of two; the first entry of A and of B normalized to contain the identity (a relabeling)
class_key: nauty canonical certificate (pynauty) of the typed Tanner graph of the full generated row set (run.full_lift_rows, run.keys_of_full), not of the library's retained display and not a WL hash: WL over-separates on the retained display and under-separates on the full rows
note: The gated records keep label, parameters, verdict, and cell; the staged candidate files are gitignored working output. Two earlier phase A passes are superseded: one keyed classes on the retained display and counted the quotient lift's own codes as new for normal subgroups, one keyed on a WL hash of the full rows and merged distinct codes. The committed pass keys on the nauty certificate.
audit: result-audit-1x2.json: audit_new.py decides each new 1x2 class against every regular 1x2 lift of the same block count by (n, rank_X, rank_Z, intersection) and, on a match, by research/audits/permutation_audit.decide
